key_insight: Lean-QIT builds a machine-checked Lean 4 foundation for quantum information theory by separating operational definitions from theorem-specific analytic results.
engineering_relevance: It gives quantum software and formal-methods researchers reusable, kernel-checked components for coding theorems, capacity proofs, and future AI-assisted verification.
method: Defines composable interfaces for quantum states, channels, codes, and finite-block error criteria
Adds one-shot, hypothesis-testing, and asymptotic rate constructions in Lean 4
Formalizes Schumacher source coding, HSW classical capacity, and entanglement-assisted capacity with strong converse
evidence_signal: The abstract reports formalization of three major quantum information theorems as the main evaluation of the library.
watch_item: The infrastructure is currently finite-dimensional and theorem-driven, so extending it to broader models or larger-scale automation may require substantial additional formalization.
paper_title: Lean-QIT: Towards a Formal Infrastructure for Quantum Information Theory
